question_text: A departmental account is prepared to
option_a: Ascertain the profit or loss of each department
option_b: Ascertain the total profit of the business
option_c: Ascertain the capital of the business
option_d: Ascertain the total assets of the business
explanation: Departmental accounts show profit per department.

question_text: Which of the following is an objective of departmental accounts?
option_a: To compare the performance of different departments
option_b: To calculate the total profit of the business
option_c: To calculate the total capital of the business
option_d: To calculate the total assets of the business

question_text: Which of the following is an advantage of departmental accounts?
option_a: It helps to identify the most profitable department
option_c: It helps to reduce total sales
option_d: It helps to increase total expenses

question_text: Which of the following is a disadvantage of departmental accounts?
option_c: It helps to identify profitable departments

question_text: Departmental expenses are expenses that
option_a: Can be directly attributed to a department
option_b: Cannot be attributed to a department
option_c: Are incurred by the whole business

question_text: General expenses are expenses that
option_a: Cannot be directly attributed to a department
option_b: Can be directly attributed to a department
option_c: Are incurred by one department only
explanation: General expenses cannot be directly attributed.

question_text: Which of the following is a basis for apportioning rent among departments?
explanation: Rent is apportioned by floor area.

question_text: Which of the following is a basis for apportioning lighting expenses among departments?
explanation: Lighting is apportioned by light points.

question_text: Which of the following is a basis for apportioning insurance among departments?
explanation: Insurance is apportioned by value of stock/assets.

question_text: Which of the following is a basis for apportioning salaries among departments?
explanation: Salaries are apportioned by number of employees.

question_text: Which of the following is a basis for apportioning carriage inwards among departments?
explanation: Carriage inwards is apportioned by cost of goods sold.

question_text: Which of the following is a basis for apportioning advertising among departments?
explanation: Advertising is apportioned by sales value.

A branch is distinguished from a department because a branch
option_a: Operates under the same roof as the head office
option_b: Is located outside the head office and can replicate all head office activities

option_d: Is always more profitable than a department
explanation: A branch is outside the head office.

question_text: When goods are sent to a branch, the value of goods sent is
option_a: Debited to the branch current account
option_b: Debited to the head office current account
option_c: Credited to the head office current account
option_d: Credited to the branch current account
explanation: Goods sent to branch are debited to branch current account.

question_text: The branch current account is maintained by the
explanation: The head office maintains the branch current account.

question_text: The head office current account is maintained by the
explanation: The branch maintains the head office current account.

question_text: Goods sent to branch at cost price means
option_a: The branch is charged at the cost price of the goods
option_b: The branch is charged at the selling price
option_c: The branch is charged at a profit
option_d: The branch is charged at a loss
explanation: At cost means charged at cost price.

question_text: Goods sent to branch at selling price means
option_a: The branch is charged at the cost price of the goods
option_b: The branch is charged at the selling price
option_c: The branch is charged at a profit
option_d: The branch is charged at a loss
explanation: At selling price means charged at selling price.

question_text: Which of the following is a feature of a branch account?
option_a: It is prepared by the head office
option_b: It is prepared by the branch
option_c: It is prepared by the bank
option_d: It is prepared by the customer
explanation: The head office prepares the branch account.

question_text: Which of the following is a feature of a branch account?
option_a: It shows the profit or loss of the branch
option_b: It shows the profit or loss of the head office
option_c: It shows the capital of the branch
option_d: It shows the assets of the branch
explanation: It shows the branch's profit or loss.

question_text: Branch stock account is prepared to
option_a: Determine the value of stock at the branch
option_b: Determine the profit of the branch
option_c: Determine the capital of the branch
option_d: Determine the assets of the branch
explanation: Branch stock account determines branch stock.

question_text: Which of the following is a type of branch?
explanation: There are dependent and independent branches.

question_text: A dependent branch is one that
option_a: Does not maintain its own books of accounts
option_b: Maintains its own books of accounts
option_c: Is located within the head office
explanation: Dependent branches do not keep full books.

question_text: An independent branch is one that
option_a: Maintains its own books of accounts
option_b: Does not maintain its own books of accounts
option_c: Is located within the head office

question_text: Which of the following is a method of preparing branch accounts?
explanation: Both are methods of preparing branch accounts.

question_text: The stock and debtors method is used when
option_a: Goods are sent to branch at selling price
option_b: Goods are sent to branch at cost price
explanation: Stock and debtors method is used for selling price.

question_text: The debtors method is used when
option_a: Goods are sent to branch at cost price
option_b: Goods are sent to branch at selling price
explanation: Debtors method is used for cost price.

question_text: Which of the following is an advantage of a branch account?
option_a: It helps to determine the profitability of each branch
option_c: It helps to reduce total sales
option_d: It helps to increase total expenses

question_text: Which of the following is a limitation of a branch account?
option_c: It helps to determine branch profitability
